description: This file defines ASN.1 structures and classes for the F1AP protocol used in 3GPP TS specifications, including message types, procedures, and container structures for F1AP messages.

classes.name: f1ap_pdu_c
classes.description: Represents the F1AP Protocol Data Unit (PDU) as a choice of message types including initiation, success, and failure responses.

classes.name: init_msg_s
classes.description: Represents an initiating F1AP message with procedure code, criticality, and message content.

classes.name: successful_outcome_s
classes.description: Represents a successful F1AP message with procedure code, criticality, and message content.

classes.name: unsuccessful_outcome_s
classes.description: Represents a failed F1AP message with procedure code, criticality, and message content.

classes.name: f1ap_elem_procs_o
classes.description: Object set of F1AP elementary procedures, including various request, response, and failure message types.

methods.name: pack
methods.description: Serializes the message into a bit buffer.

methods.name: unpack
methods.description: Deserializes the message from a bit buffer.

methods.name: to_json
methods.description: Converts the message to JSON format.

methods.name: load_info_obj
methods.description: Loads message info based on procedure code.
